entries.why: PR #562 form follow-up cards and QR sharing. Only tenants/{tenantId}/forms/{formId} changes: clients may create without followUp, update only when followUp is unchanged, and delete with existing forms permission. Server validates references. Emulator coverage is added; founder approval is required before the auto-deploying rules are merged.

PR #562 review fixes: validate bounded form content and total request bytes server-side before saving, and require fresh tenant membership with current or legacy forms permission before any write.
PR #562 review fixes: re-prove users/{uid} tenant membership before loading follow-up choices, preserving the super admin exception and the legacy seeFormsInbox permission.
PR #562 review fixes: share the current users/{uid} membership check across form saving and follow-up choices, before permission checks, and honor manageForms or the legacy seeFormsInbox grant.
PR #562 review fixes: enforce server-side form title, description, field count, field shape, option and text limits, with an overall byte ceiling below the Firestore document size limit.
PR #562 founder decision and review fixes: allow Free tenants to select public same-tenant follow-ups, validate community host slugs, and exclude courses whose access is restricted.

PR #562 regression coverage: stale tenant claims cannot read choices or write forms, legacy admins retain access, oversized or malformed forms are rejected, Free works, and slug and course access checks hold.
PR #562 review fixes: resolve the ministry subdomain from its tenant document for QR, copy, embed and open links; withhold sharing and surface a visible error if its public address cannot be loaded.
PR #562 review fixes: preserve existing builder assertions while proving form links and QR codes use the resolved tenant subdomain, and missing, invalid or failed address reads render an error.
